-- fs --
home/evan/émile.txt
home/evan/other.txt
home/evan/Müsik/lied.mp3
home/evan/世界/地図.png
-- script --
start /home/evan
size 60 8
note the cursor is counted in letters, not bytes: é is one letter and two bytes
type é
snapshot ghost
press right
state filter émile.txt
press ctrl+u
type ~/Mü
snapshot path
press right
state filter ~/Müsik/
press ctrl+u
type 世
press right
state filter 世界/
